keep._note: Only these Japanese sets are built into the site and get price refreshes. Chosen 2026-10-26: (1) 2018–2026 hot tier = top 36 by a composite of two SNKRDUNK signals (total active listings across the set = trading activity, and sum of the 3 highest chase-card prices = chase value; average of the two percentile ranks), plus 4 widely known high-class/anniversary sets that rank lower only because their cards are cheap and plentiful (シャイニートレジャーex, テラスタルフェスex, VSTARユニバース, 25th アニバーサリーコレクション); (2) 9 iconic classics (first Japanese set, Jungle, Fossil, Rocket, neo Genesis, neo Destiny, e-card Base, Dragon Frontiers, 20th Anniversary). Remove a key here to drop a set; add a ja:ID key to restore one (raw data is untouched).
